## Agentic App Tester — Agents explore, rules decide
AI agents (Gemini free tier) play 4 personas: low vision, hand tremor, first-time user, scam-anxious user. They look at the screen, decide where to tap, and change plan when stuck.
Every finding must be confirmed by a FIXED check (axe-core, tap size, spacing, font size, zoom, broken links, console errors, dead taps). Severity = fixed rules in "Fixed severity rules". AI never decides severity.
Needs: helper server running (`npm run server`) and GEMINI_API_KEY in test-harness/.env (not in this workflow).
